stories.h: Fox News presenters Sean Hannity and Ainsley Earhardt reportedly marry in Florida
stories.p: Fox News presenters Sean Hannity and Ainsley Earhardt have reportedly married in Florida after a pre-wedding party said to have been attended by Donald Trump. The couple announced their engagement in late 2024.
more: The pre-wedding party was reportedly attended by the US president.
The two have long been among Fox News's best-known faces.
stories.alt: Sean Hannity speaking at an event
stories.credit: Photo: Gage Skidmore / Flickr, CC BY-SA 2.0

stories.h: Kylian Mbappe reportedly scores twice in El Clasico, shaking up Ballon d'Or talk
stories.p: Kylian Mbappe has reportedly scored two goals in El Clasico, prompting fresh updates to the Ballon d'Or rankings. Fans and pundits are debating where the goals leave him in this year's race.
more: Ballon d'Or rankings have reportedly been reshuffled after the match.
Fans are debating his place in this year's race.
stories.alt: Kylian Mbappé playing for France
stories.credit: Photo: Кирилл Венедиктов / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 3.0

stories.h: Hurzeler reportedly denies interest in the Manchester United head coach job
stories.p: Brighton boss Fabian Hurzeler has reportedly dismissed talk linking him with the Manchester United job. Reports say he is focused on his current club, while speculation continues over who could succeed Michael Carrick.
more: Several other managers are being tipped online as possible replacements.
United have not commented on the speculation.

stories.h: Rita Edochie clarifies her stance on polygamy
stories.p: Nollywood actress Rita Edochie has reportedly explained that she is not against polygamy, in comments that have drawn mixed reactions online.
more: Her remarks have been widely shared on social media.
Fans are divided over her explanation.

stories.h: Zookeeper in coma after reported leopard attack at Dutch safari park
stories.p: A zookeeper at Safaripark Beekse Bergen in the Netherlands is reportedly in a critical condition and sedated after being attacked by a leopard. The park is said to be investigating how the incident happened.
more: Emergency services were reportedly called to the scene.
The park has not given further details on the keeper's condition.

stories.h: Lady shocked at how hot solar panels on a neighbouring building became under the sun
stories.p: A lady has gone viral after showing how hot the solar panels on a three-storey building next to her house had become under the scorching sun, saying she never imagined they could generate that much heat. Solar panels can get extremely hot in direct sunlight, with surface temperatures sometimes reaching 60°C to 80°C or more in very hot weather. They are designed to turn sunlight into electricity, but they also absorb heat, and too much heat can actually reduce how well they work.
more: A panel feeling very hot does not mean it is faulty or about to catch fire; smoke, flames, a burning smell or visible damage would be the warning signs.
More Nigerians are installing rooftop solar because of the electricity situation.
But how many people really understand how these systems work?
stories.alt: Sunlight glares off solar panels on the dark roof of a cream three-storey building, seen from a neighbouring rooftop
stories.credit: Image: social media

stories.h: APC youth leaders receive Toyota Prado SUVs for election mobilisation
stories.p: APC National Youth Leader Dayo Israel has shared a video saying he presented Toyota Prado SUVs to selected youth leaders to support the party's election mobilisation. At least seven vehicles appear in the footage, some branded with the APC logo. Israel also thanked First Lady Oluremi Tinubu for her continuing support.
more: The handover comes as parties step up campaigning ahead of the 2027 elections.
It follows earlier debate online over branded SUVs being used for the 2027 campaign.
The party has not said how many youth leaders will receive vehicles in total.
stories.alt: Black Toyota Prado SUVs, one branded "All Progressives Congress, Government House Abuja", parked on a street in Abuja
stories.credit: Image: social media

stories.h: NDC reportedly unveils its 2027 campaign council with Peter Obi, Kwankwaso and Dickson
stories.p: The Nigeria Democratic Congress has reportedly named its campaign council for the 2027 elections. The list is said to include presidential candidate Peter Obi, his running mate Rabiu Kwankwaso and party leader Seriake Dickson.
more: The announcement follows weeks of meetings in Abuja over the council's make-up.
The party had earlier dismissed reports of division over the Obi-Kwankwaso ticket.
stories.alt: Peter Obi
stories.credit: Photo: Plus TV Africa / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 3.0

stories.h: Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala announces the death of her mother, Prof Kamene Okonjo, aged 96
stories.p: WTO Director-General Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala has announced that her mother, Professor Kamene Okonjo, has died at the age of 96. Tributes are expected from across Nigeria and beyond.
more: Prof Okonjo was a respected academic and a former traditional title holder in Delta State.
The family is expected to announce funeral arrangements.
stories.alt: Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala speaking at a conference
stories.credit: Photo: Perambara/Amantha Perera / Flickr, CC BY 2.0

stories.h: Zamfara steps up Ebola screening after a traveller reportedly arrives with a fever
stories.p: The Zamfara State government has reportedly activated Ebola surveillance at Gusau airport and major motor parks. This follows the arrival of a passenger from Saudi Arabia said to have had a 38-degree fever.
more: Health officials have urged residents to report anyone with symptoms.
It comes as the NCDC approves weekly payments for people placed under monitoring.

stories.h: NFL and players' union reportedly review Jalen Hurts' blood clot diagnosis
stories.p: The NFL and the NFL Players Association are reportedly jointly investigating the medical care given to Philadelphia Eagles quarterback Jalen Hurts after a blood clot diagnosis.
more: The review is said to focus on how the condition was identified and treated.
There is no official word yet on when he could return to play.
stories.alt: Jalen Hurts
stories.credit: Photo: All-Pro Reels / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 2.0

stories.h: UK Defence Secretary says Britain must be ready for war within 1,000 days
stories.p: The UK Defence Secretary has said Britain must strengthen its military readiness because potential adversaries could be able to attack by around 2030.
more: The warning is aimed at pushing faster investment in the armed forces.
Opposition parties are expected to press for details on funding.

stories.h: Soludo reportedly rules out automatic Anambra backing for Peter Obi in 2027
stories.p: Anambra Governor Charles Soludo has reportedly said the state will not back Peter Obi by default in the 2027 presidential race. He is said to have argued that the 2027 contest will not be a repeat of 2023.
more: The remark adds to the debate over how Obi will fare in his home region.
Obi supporters have previously said he does not need any coalition to win.

stories.h: Labour body reportedly warned of risks ahead of new minimum wage demand
stories.p: A fresh warning has reportedly been issued to the Nigeria Labour Congress over possible consequences if its new minimum wage demand is approved. Details of the demand and the response from government were still being discussed.
more: Workers have long pressed for pay to keep pace with prices.
Government and employers are yet to agree a new figure.

stories.h: Spanish media reportedly criticise Lookman after another early substitution at Atletico Madrid
stories.p: Ademola Lookman was reportedly taken off in the first half for the third time in four La Liga games, drawing criticism from the Spanish press. The Nigeria forward is said to be struggling to hold down a regular role.
more: Fans in Nigeria are watching his form closely.
Atletico have not publicly explained the changes.

stories.h: Victor Osimhen's record against Fenerbahce in focus ahead of Istanbul derby
stories.p: Attention is turning to Victor Osimhen's past results against Fenerbahce ahead of the Istanbul derby. The Nigeria striker is expected to be central to his side's hopes in the big match.
more: Turkish fans are expecting a tense, high-scoring night.
Nigerian supporters will be tuning in to watch him.

stories.h: Atiku criticises reports of security agents guarding Tinubu campaign banners in Kaduna
stories.p: Atiku Abubakar has reportedly criticised claims that security personnel were stationed to protect APC campaign banners in Kaduna. The former vice-president, now a leading opposition figure, said public security resources should not be used for party materials. There has been no official response from the APC or the security agencies in the reports seen so far.
more: Campaign banners have become a flashpoint as parties step up activity ahead of 2027.
The APC has not commented in the reports seen so far.

stories.h: Kwankwaso says Tinubu does not deserve a second term
stories.p: Rabiu Kwankwaso has reportedly said President Tinubu has not earned a second term in office. He pointed to the cost of living and the state of the economy as reasons. Supporters of the president have defended his reforms as necessary for long-term growth.
more: Kwankwaso is part of the opposition NDC platform alongside Peter Obi.
The APC says the economy is stabilising under the reforms.

stories.h: Pantami says he will expose those allegedly plotting against his Gombe governorship bid
stories.p: Former minister Isa Ali Pantami has reportedly said he will name those he alleges are working against his bid to become governor of Gombe State. He did not give details in the reports seen so far. Those he appears to refer to have not responded publicly.
more: The Gombe race is already drawing attention ahead of 2027.
No names have been confirmed in reports so far.

stories.h: Macron reportedly postpones planned 28 October visit to Nigeria
stories.p: French President Emmanuel Macron has reportedly delayed his planned trip to Nigeria, which was due on 28 October. No new date has been given in the reports seen so far. The visit had been expected to focus on trade and security ties.
more: No reason for the delay has been confirmed in the reports seen so far.
A new date has not been announced.

stories.h: Kano Hisbah reportedly detains TikToker and two other women over dance videos
stories.p: The Kano State Hisbah board has reportedly detained a TikToker, Amani Ishaq, and two other women over dance videos it considers immoral. The agency enforces Islamic moral rules in the state. It has not said what will happen next, according to the reports seen so far.
more: Hisbah has made similar arrests of content creators in the past.
Reaction on social media has been mixed.

stories.h: Former BBNaija housemate Mike Edwards surprised by DNA ancestry result
stories.p: Former Big Brother Naija housemate Mike Edwards has reportedly shared a DNA test that shows his ancestry is mainly Igbo and Yoruba. He said he was surprised by the result. The post has drawn reactions from fans online.
more: DNA ancestry tests have become a popular trend among Nigerian celebrities.
Fans have been sharing their own results in reply.

stories.h: Arsenal winger Bukayo Saka reportedly out for up to eight weeks with injury
stories.p: Arsenal winger Bukayo Saka is reportedly facing up to eight weeks on the sidelines with an injury. The club is said to be assessing the best treatment plan. The news is a blow to Arsenal in the Premier League title race.
more: Arsenal have not given a firm return date in the reports seen so far.
He could miss a busy run of league and European games.

stories.h: Cristiano Ronaldo reportedly scores his 982nd career goal
stories.p: Cristiano Ronaldo has reportedly scored again, taking his career tally to 982 goals. He continues to add to a record that no other player is close to matching. Fans are discussing how near he is to the 1,000 mark.
more: The 1,000-goal milestone is his stated target.
Reaction online has been strong among both fans and critics.

stories.h: Manchester United goalkeeper Andre Onana reportedly escapes serious injury in car crash in Turkey
stories.p: Goalkeeper Andre Onana has reportedly been involved in a car crash in Turkey and escaped without serious injury. Details of the incident are limited in the reports seen so far. No official statement from his club has been seen yet.
more: He is said to be safe and well.
The cause of the crash has not been confirmed.

stories.h: US Justice Department reportedly charges two former FBI officials over testimony on Hunter Biden laptop
stories.p: The US Justice Department has reportedly charged two former FBI officials in connection with their testimony about the Hunter Biden laptop. Details of the charges have not been fully set out in the reports seen so far. Lawyers for the two have not been quoted.
more: The laptop story has been a political flashpoint in the US for years.
The two are presumed innocent unless proven otherwise.

stories.h: Analyst says Governor Makinde's 2027 presidential bid is a test of the waters, not a serious bid to win
stories.p: A political analyst has reportedly described Oyo State Governor Seyi Makinde's move towards the 2027 presidential race as exploratory. The analyst said it appears aimed at gauging support rather than a determined push to win. Makinde's camp has not been quoted in the report.
more: The 2027 field is already crowded, with APC, ADC and NDC camps all making their pitch.
Analysts say the North-West and South-West could decide the race.

stories.h: Mother and child reportedly die as two container trucks overturn in Lagos
stories.p: A mother and her child have reportedly died after two container trucks overturned at Mile 2 in Apapa, Lagos. Emergency responders are said to have been called to the scene. The cause of the accident has not been confirmed.
more: Heavy container traffic around the Apapa corridor has long been a safety concern.
Further details from the authorities are awaited.
stories.alt: Container trucks on a highway
stories.credit: Stock image: futureatlas.com / Flickr, CC BY 2.0

stories.h: Woman says friends were killed in Edo even after N25 million ransom was paid for each of them
stories.p: A woman has reportedly cried out online over the deaths of friends in Edo State, saying a ransom of N25 million was paid for each of them before they were killed. The claim has not been independently confirmed. It has renewed debate about kidnapping and insecurity in the state.
more: Nigerians online are calling on security agencies to act.
The police have not yet responded to the claim.

stories.h: Baby in Ecuador reportedly born with a full moustache
stories.p: A newborn baby in Ecuador has gone viral after reportedly arriving with what looks like a full moustache. While most newborns are still struggling to open their eyes, this little one allegedly came out looking like he already has a wife, three children and bills to pay. Photos of the baby, wrapped in a towel with dark hair above his lip, have been shared widely online.
more: Social media users have been flooding the photos with jokes about the baby's "grown man" look.
Some newborns are born with extra fine body hair, which usually falls off within the first weeks of life.
The details of the birth have not been independently confirmed.
stories.alt: A newborn baby with curly wet hair and dark hair above his upper lip, wrapped in a white towel
stories.credit: Image: social media

stories.h: Lagos reportedly plans 30-minute driver's licences and 10-minute renewals from 2027
stories.p: The Lagos State government is said to be working on a much faster driver's licence process that would start in 2027. New licences would reportedly be issued in about 30 minutes, while renewals would take around 10. No further details on cost or locations have been given yet.
more: The state has been talking about issuing its own licences in partnership with the federal government.
Drivers currently often wait weeks or months for a card.

stories.h: Fulani leaders reportedly present three demands to Tinubu on the N30 trillion livestock sector
stories.p: Fulani leaders have reportedly set out three requests to President Tinubu about Nigeria's livestock sector, which is said to be worth about N30 trillion. The group wants the sector given more attention and support from government.
more: The sector supports millions of herders and traders across the country.
The presidency has not yet been reported to have responded.

stories.h: NCDC approves N100,000 weekly payments for people under Ebola monitoring
stories.p: The Nigeria Centre for Disease Control has reportedly approved a weekly stipend of N100,000 for people being monitored as contacts of the confirmed Ebola case. The payment is said to be meant to help them stay at home for the monitoring period.
more: Health officials are still tracing contacts of the confirmed case in Abuja.
Neighbouring countries have tightened travel rules as the outbreak is watched.
stories.alt: Medics at work in an Ebola observation ward
stories.credit: Stock image: DFID - UK Department for International Development / Flickr, CC BY 2.0

stories.h: Naira weakens against the dollar even though reserves stand at about $55 billion
stories.p: A fresh CBN dollar rate shows the naira losing ground, reportedly despite foreign reserves of around $55 billion. The slide is drawing questions from traders and ordinary Nigerians.
more: Analysts say demand for dollars is still high.
Petrol and diesel prices are also being watched closely.

stories.h: Police arrest a tiler over the death of a hotel worker in Abuja
stories.p: Police in Abuja have arrested a tiler in connection with the death of a hotel staff member in the Utako area after a violent confrontation. The suspect reportedly told officers the man fell and hit his head.
more: Investigators are said to be looking into what led to the clash.
The police have not yet announced when the suspect will be charged.

stories.h: First Lady Remi Tinubu says she wants to leave Aso Rock in 2031
stories.p: Nigeria's First Lady Remi Tinubu has reportedly said she hopes to leave the presidential villa in 2031 for a Nigeria she can enjoy. The remark, made as the 2027 campaign gets under way, is drawing mixed reactions online.
more: Supporters read it as confidence in a second term for her husband.
Opposition voices say Nigerians want results, not predictions.

stories.h: NDLEA arrests a South African woman and a Nigerian-American grandmother at Lagos airport
stories.p: The anti-narcotics agency has reportedly detained two travellers at the Lagos airport, one of them a South African woman said to have been carrying about 36 kilograms of cocaine. The second is a Nigerian-American grandmother. Further details on the second case were not immediately available.
more: The South African woman was reportedly found with 36.65kg of the drug.
The agency has not said when the suspects will be charged.
stories.alt: Suitcases lined up in an airport baggage hall (stock image)
stories.credit: Stock image: Chor Ip / Flickr, CC BY-SA 2.0

stories.h: Tacha tells Big Brother Naija organisers what they must do to win viewers back
stories.p: Former housemate Tacha has reportedly given the organisers of Big Brother Naija her advice on how to win back viewers. Her comments are said to have sparked a conversation among fans of the reality show.
more: Fans have been sharing their own views on the show online.
stories.alt: A television remote control (stock image)
stories.credit: Stock image: Dmitry Makeev / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0

stories.h: What really happened between Bella Shmurda and Davido? Wedding moment raises eyebrows
stories.p: A moment involving singers Bella Shmurda and Davido at Zlatan Ibile's traditional wedding has sparked reactions on social media. In a clip now circulating online, Bella Shmurda approaches the area where Davido is seated but appears to reach past him to shake hands with the person sitting right next to him. Given how close the two were, some viewers believe it would have been hard for Bella not to notice Davido, and that is what has people talking.
more: Some fans are asking whether it was a deliberate snub.
Others wonder if something is going on between the two artists that the public does not know about.
Or are Nigerians simply reading too much into an ordinary moment? Neither singer has commented.
stories.alt: Guests in traditional attire shake hands at Zlatan Ibile's wedding
stories.credit: Image: social media

stories.h: Eniola Badmus and Davido at Zlatan Ibile's wedding: a reunion that has fans talking
stories.p: Nollywood actress Eniola Badmus and Afrobeats star Davido have caught the attention of social media users after both appeared at Zlatan Ibile's lavish wedding celebration. The two were once known as close friends, with Eniola openly cheering the singer on through different stages of his career. Their relationship was reported to have cooled after the death of Davido's son, Ifeanyi, in 2022, when the actress faced heavy criticism online over posts about the tragedy. Neither of them has said whether their differences have been settled, so attending the same wedding may not mean the friendship is back.
more: Friendships in the entertainment industry can cool through misunderstandings or public pressure, and sometimes recover quietly away from the cameras.
Zlatan's wedding brought together some of the biggest names in Nigerian entertainment, and fans are following every moment.
Would you like to see Davido and Eniola Badmus rebuild their old friendship, or are some friendships better left in the past?
stories.alt: Davido, in a red cap, smiles as he hugs a guest in a gele at Zlatan Ibile's wedding
stories.credit: Image: social media

stories.h: Dangote Cement reportedly lines up a $1bn London share sale as the boss visits the stock exchange
stories.p: Dangote Cement is reportedly preparing to sell about 10 per cent of the company to investors in London, a deal that could raise around $1 billion as early as November. The sale is said to involve existing shareholders rather than new shares, with Goldman Sachs and UBS reportedly arranging it. Aliko Dangote was reported to have visited the London Stock Exchange as investor meetings were expected to begin from 27 October.
more: Investor sessions are reportedly planned for London, South Africa and Dubai.
The timing is said to depend on market conditions.
stories.alt: Aliko Dangote
stories.credit: Photo: World Economic Forum / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 2.0

stories.h: Natasha Osawaru shares a video of Peter Obi, drawing reactions ahead of 2027
stories.p: Edo lawmaker and 2Baba's wife Natasha Osawaru reportedly posted a video of Peter Obi, the NDC presidential candidate, and it has drawn mixed reactions online. She earlier backed Obi and Rabiu Kwankwaso at the NDC convention and has since won the party's ticket for her state assembly seat.
more: She is set to contest the Egor seat in 2027.
Supporters of other parties have also joined the online debate.
stories.alt: Peter Obi
stories.credit: Photo: VOA / Wikimedia Commons, Public domain

stories.h: Gunmen kill at least 10 people in eastern Nigeria, police confirm
stories.p: Gunmen have killed at least 10 people in an attack in eastern Nigeria, police have confirmed. The killings have renewed serious concern about the worsening security situation in parts of the country, where communities continue to face threats from armed attackers. Behind the death toll are grieving families whose lives have been changed forever.
more: Many Nigerians are asking how long lives will continue to be lost to gun violence.
Protecting lives and property remains one of the government's most important duties.
Nigerians say they deserve to live, work and travel without constant fear for their safety.
stories.alt: Armed police officers in helmets and vests line a street in a Nigerian town
stories.credit: Image: social media

stories.h: Jay-Z praises daughter Blue Ivy after she joins him on stage on piano
stories.p: Jay-Z reportedly bowed to his 14-year-old daughter, Blue Ivy, and hyped her up when she joined him on stage and performed on the piano. Clips of the moment are said to be circulating widely online.
more: Blue Ivy has increasingly appeared on stage with her parents in recent years.
Fans online praised the father-daughter moment.
stories.alt: Jay-Z at a Shawn Carter Foundation event
stories.credit: Photo: Joella Marano from Manhattan, NY / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 3.0

stories.h: Report says insecurity is worsening in Nigeria even as a stability index shows rising economic confidence
stories.p: A new report reportedly shows insecurity getting worse across Nigeria, while a separate stability index points to improving economic confidence. The mixed picture is drawing attention as the 2027 campaign season gets under way.
more: The report is said to highlight kidnappings and attacks in several states.
Analysts say economic confidence and security perceptions do not always move together.
stories.alt: Nigeria supporters in green and white hold up the national flag (stock image)
stories.credit: Stock image: manbeastextraordinaire / Flickr, CC BY 2.0

stories.h: Nigeria Customs shares an update on its recruitment exercise
stories.p: The Nigeria Customs Service has reportedly issued fresh details on its recruitment exercise, which it says is moving to an annual cycle. Candidates are advised to rely only on the service's official channels for information.
more: The previous exercise reportedly selected 3,852 candidates from more than 573,000 applicants.
Successful candidates have been told to watch their registered email and SMS for instructions.
stories.alt: Stacks of shipping containers at a port (stock image)
stories.credit: Stock image: Unknown / Rawpixel, CC0 1.0

stories.h: Brother and sister both graduate with first-class degrees from UNILORIN
stories.p: A brother and sister have both reportedly earned first-class degrees from the University of Ilorin, in different departments and with different CGPAs. Their achievement is being celebrated online.
more: The University of Ilorin has had several widely shared first-class stories this week.
Congratulations poured in from netizens.
stories.alt: Graduates' mortarboard caps at a ceremony (stock image)
stories.credit: Stock image: j.o.h.n. walker / Flickr, CC BY 2.0

stories.h: Davido's reaction as a DJ plays a Wizkid song at Zlatan Ibile's wedding gets fans talking
stories.p: A DJ reportedly played a Wizkid track at Zlatan Ibile's wedding, and Davido's reaction in the moment has been shared widely. Fans are debating what his expression meant.
more: Clips of the moment are circulating on social media.
Fans of both singers have joined the debate.
stories.alt: Davido performing on stage in Lagos
stories.credit: Photo: Kaizenify / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0

stories.h: Eniola Badmus draws attention at Zlatan's wedding as Iyabo Ojo and Ini Edo react
stories.p: Actress Eniola Badmus reportedly stood out at Zlatan Ibile's wedding with her outfit, and fellow actresses Iyabo Ojo and Ini Edo are said to have reacted. Her moment with Davido at the event has also been noticed online.
more: Photos of her outfit are being shared on social media.
Other guests also reacted to her look.
stories.alt: Singer Zlatan Ibile, whose wedding drew Nollywood stars
stories.credit: Photo: WALINTEEN PRO / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY 3.0)

stories.h: Nigerians turn to solar panels as wedding gifts amid power cuts and high petrol prices
stories.p: Some couples are reportedly asking for solar panels as wedding presents because of frequent power outages and the cost of fuel. The trend reflects how households are looking for alternatives to the national grid and petrol generators.
more: The gifts are said to be replacing traditional household items.
Demand for solar equipment has reportedly been rising.
stories.alt: Rows of solar panels on a roof (stock image)
stories.credit: Stock image: Dave Dugdale / Flickr, CC BY-SA 2.0

stories.h: UNILORIN awards a second PhD to a nurse who already holds four degrees
stories.p: The University of Ilorin has reportedly awarded a second doctorate to a nurse who already has two bachelor's degrees and two master's degrees. The story is drawing admiration online.
more: The nurse's academic record has been widely shared.
stories.alt: A stethoscope on a desk (stock image)
stories.credit: Stock image: jasleen_kaur / Flickr, CC BY-SA 2.0

stories.h: Cash showers and a mystery spender: guests reportedly splash dollars at Zlatan Ibile's wedding
stories.p: Davido and singer OGB Recent are said to have showered Zlatan Ibile and his bride with bundles of cash, while an unidentified man reportedly sprayed money on actress Iyabo Ojo. Fans have been asking who the man is, and the spraying has stirred debate online. Davido's playful answer about his favourite food at the event has also been widely shared.
more: Videos of the spraying have been shared widely on social media.
Davido's reply naming his wife Chioma drew warm reactions.
Fans are still trying to identify the man who sprayed Iyabo Ojo.
stories.alt: Singer Zlatan Ibile
stories.credit: Photo: WALINTEEN PRO / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY 3.0)

stories.h: Analysis says North-West and South-West could decide the 2027 presidential race
stories.p: An analysis based on the 2026 voter register argues that the North-West and South-West hold the most voters and could swing the 2027 presidential election. The parties are expected to focus their campaigns on both zones. The figures come from the electoral commission's register.
more: Both zones carry the largest voter numbers on the register.
Campaign teams across the parties are likely to target them.
stories.alt: Ballot boxes lined up on tables (stock image)
stories.credit: Stock image: secretlondon123 / Flickr, CC BY-SA 2.0

stories.h: Late gospel singer Toluwanisings' father reportedly speaks on his son's move from Islam to Christianity
stories.p: The father of the late gospel singer Toluwanisings has reportedly addressed his son's Muslim upbringing and later conversion to Christianity. The singer had said in an earlier interview that he grew up Muslim before becoming a Christian. The comments have drawn sympathetic reactions online.
more: The singer had described his conversion as the best choice of his life.
Tributes to him have continued since his death earlier this month.
stories.alt: A church choir in red robes sings during a service (stock image)
stories.credit: Stock image: Zeetz Jones / Flickr, CC BY 2.0

stories.h: Ntel reportedly returns to the Nigerian market with cheaper internet plans and eSIM
stories.p: Telecom operator Ntel is reportedly back in Nigeria with lower-priced internet bundles and eSIM support. The company is said to be targeting price-sensitive subscribers as data costs remain a concern. Details of its coverage have not been confirmed.
more: Ntel earlier served only a few major cities.
The relaunch comes as other operators also push eSIM.
stories.alt: A smartphone and laptop on a desk (stock image)
stories.credit: Stock image: D Coetzee / Flickr, CC0 1.0

stories.h: Peller reportedly accuses Jarvis's family of disrespect, and Jarvis hits back
stories.p: Streamer Peller has reportedly said a member of Jarvis's family refused to greet him even in his own home. Jarvis is said to have answered by rejecting pressure to show him respect, in a reply that has split fans online. The pair's on-and-off relationship has drawn heavy attention for months.
more: The exchange has been shared widely on TikTok and Instagram.
Fans are divided, with some backing Peller and others siding with Jarvis.
Neither has said whether they plan to settle the matter privately.
stories.alt: Streamer Peller
stories.credit: Photo: Haxorpy / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 4.0

stories.h: Regina Daniels reportedly breaks her silence after a video of a heated exchange with her mother goes viral
stories.p: Actress Regina Daniels has reportedly responded after a clip of a tense confrontation with her mother spread widely online. The video drew a flood of comments from fans, many of them divided over what the exchange meant. It comes amid months of public attention on her family and marriage.
more: The clip has been shared across Instagram and X, with fans taking sides.
Her mother has been in the headlines several times this year over family matters.
Neither side has given full details of what led to the exchange.
stories.alt: Actress Regina Daniels in sunglasses
stories.credit: Photo: Patrice Andrew / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0

stories.h: Shettima leads a Nigerian delegation to Ethiopia to study its nutrition programme
stories.p: Vice President Kashim Shettima is heading a delegation to Ethiopia to learn how the country has tackled malnutrition. Officials say the lessons will be adapted for Nigeria's N774 nutrition drive. The visit is part of efforts to cut child hunger across the country.
more: The delegation includes health and agriculture officials.
The N774 nutrition drive targets every local government area.
Ethiopia is often cited for its community-based feeding model.
stories.alt: A view over Addis Ababa, Ethiopia (stock image)
stories.credit: Stock image: neiljs / Flickr, CC BY 2.0

stories.h: Eight Zamfara lawmakers reportedly return to the APC, with Matawalle praised for the move
stories.p: Eight lawmakers in Zamfara State have reportedly rejoined the ruling APC, with supporters of Bello Matawalle crediting him for the return. The development comes as parties reshuffle their ranks ahead of the 2027 elections. Opposition figures have not yet commented.
more: Defections and returns are increasing as 2027 campaigns gather pace.
Supporters hailed the move as a boost for the APC in the north-west.
It is not yet clear which parties the lawmakers had been with.
stories.alt: Aso Rock, Abuja
stories.credit: Photo: Akum20 / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0

stories.h: DMI backs Tinubu's economic reforms and announces an alliance ahead of 2027
stories.p: A group known as DMI has declared support for President Tinubu's economic reforms and announced an alliance with his campaign for the 2027 elections. The announcement follows the APC's campaign flag-off. Rival parties continue to court voters on cost-of-living concerns.
more: The alliance was announced a day after Tinubu's campaign speech in Kaduna.
Opposition parties say the reforms have worsened hardship.
Campaign groups on all sides are announcing alliances this week.
stories.alt: Portrait of President Bola Tinubu
stories.credit: Photo: Nosa Asemota / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0

stories.h: Uganda restricts transit for travellers from DR Congo as it investigates an Ebola case
stories.p: Uganda has barred travellers with recent DR Congo travel history from passing through the country while health officials investigate an Ebola case. The measure is meant to limit spread across the border. Neighbouring countries are on alert.
more: Nigeria confirmed an Ebola case in Abuja this week.
Health officials in the region are tracing contacts.
Travel advisories are expected to be updated.
stories.alt: Electron micrograph of Ebola virus particles
stories.credit: Photo: BernbaumJG / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY 4.0)

stories.h: Nollywood actor claims the late Francis Duru was poisoned, stirring debate
stories.p: A popular actor has alleged that veteran Francis Duru was poisoned, a claim that has divided Nigerians online. No evidence has been made public to support the allegation, and the family has not confirmed it. Many fans have urged caution while mourning the actor.
more: Nollywood colleagues have paid tributes since his death.
Some fans have asked for the claim to be backed with evidence.
The allegation remains unverified.
stories.alt: Francis Duru
stories.credit: Photo: VOA/Gilbert Tamba / Wikimedia Commons, Public domain

stories.h: Pastor Adeboye blesses his granddaughter on her wedding day in Baltimore
stories.p: The General Overseer of the RCCG, Pastor Enoch Adeboye, and his wife travelled to Baltimore in the United States for their granddaughter's wedding. Photos and videos of the ceremony and his blessing have been widely shared. Church members sent congratulations online.
more: The couple were seen praying with the newlyweds.
Many Nigerians in the diaspora attended.
Congratulatory messages poured in from church members.
stories.alt: Pastor Enoch Adeboye preaching at a lectern
stories.credit: Photo: Ganzyg / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0

stories.h: Wike makes fresh claim about helping Peter Obi become a presidential candidate
stories.p: FCT Minister Nyesom Wike has reportedly made a new claim about his role in Peter Obi's political journey, saying he helped put him on the path to a presidential ticket. A separate report says Wike also spoke about what could stop Obi from winning the presidency in 2027. Obi's camp has not been reported to respond.
more: Wike has repeatedly commented on Obi as the 2027 race heats up.
Obi is running on the NDC ticket with Kwankwaso.
stories.alt: Nyesom Wike
stories.credit: Photo: Hygist / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY 4.0)

stories.h: Seyi Vodi reportedly turned away by bouncers at Zlatan Ibile's wedding
stories.p: Content creator Seyi Vodi was reportedly denied entry to Zlatan Ibile and Davita's wedding by security staff, and Nigerians have reacted online. It is not clear whether he had an invitation. Many other stars attended the celebration.
more: Davido and Enioluwa were among the guests.
Videos from the wedding continue to circulate online.
stories.alt: Singer Zlatan Ibile
stories.credit: Photo: WALINTEEN PRO / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY 3.0)

stories.h: Tope Alabi reportedly gives Canada-based pastor 24 hours over online claims about Toluwanisings' death
stories.p: Gospel singer Tope Alabi has reportedly given a Canada-based pastor a 24-hour ultimatum in the controversy surrounding the death of Toluwanisings. This follows her earlier warning to social media users against defamation.
more: She has said she will take legal action against defamation.
Many Nigerians are weighing in online.
stories.alt: A church choir in red robes sings during a service (stock image)
stories.credit: Stock image: Zeetz Jones / Flickr, CC BY 2.0

stories.h: Marketers cut petrol prices across Nigeria while diesel climbs
stories.p: Petrol prices have reportedly fallen at filling stations in several parts of the country, while diesel is getting more expensive because of high crude oil prices.
more: Diesel affects transport and food costs.
Motorists are watching whether the petrol cut lasts.
stories.alt: An old fuel pump (stock image)
stories.credit: Stock image: Nan Palmero / Flickr, CC BY 2.0

stories.h: Shoprite reportedly makes fresh move to revive its Nigerian business
stories.p: Retailer Shoprite is said to be taking new steps to return to the Nigerian market after earlier shutting its stores in the country. Details of the plan have not been fully reported.
more: The chain had closed its Nigerian stores after selling the business.
Shoppers online are asking where the new stores would open.
stories.alt: A supermarket shopping trolley (stock image)
stories.credit: Stock image: hospi-table / Flickr, CC BY-SA 2.0

stories.h: Tinubu says opposition created the hunger and poverty it now campaigns against; Atiku calls the claim delusional
stories.p: President Tinubu accused opposition politicians of building their campaigns on hardship they helped create. Atiku Abubakar hit back, describing the remark as delusional and questioning the state of the naira and poverty levels under the current government.
more: The exchange follows the APC campaign flag-off in Kaduna.
The opposition says it will keep pressing the government on living costs.
stories.alt: Portrait of President Bola Tinubu
stories.credit: Photo: Nosa Asemota / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0

stories.h: Pat Utomi dares Tinubu to defend his record in a live presidential debate
stories.p: Political economist Pat Utomi has challenged President Tinubu to take part in a live debate and defend his achievements before the 2027 election. There was no immediate response from the presidency.
more: Debate calls are growing as the campaign season opens.
Polling day has been set for February 2027.
stories.alt: Pat Utomi speaking at a podium
stories.credit: Photo: Edirin247 / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 3.0

stories.h: Gunmen reportedly open fire on an NDC candidate's convoy in Ebonyi, killing one person
stories.p: Gunmen reportedly attacked the convoy of a candidate of the NDC in Ebonyi State, killing one person and injuring three others. Police are yet to give full details of the incident.
more: Security concerns around the 2027 campaigns are in focus.
Parties have urged the police to investigate.
stories.alt: A police car with its lights on at night (stock image)
stories.credit: Stock image: davidsonscott15 / Flickr, CC BY 2.0

stories.h: About 50 UK peers urge the Home Secretary to bar Macklemore from entering Britain before his Wembley show
stories.p: A group of about 50 peers has written to the Home Secretary asking that the rapper be stopped from entering the UK ahead of his London concert. There has been no decision reported yet.
more: The concert at Wembley is still scheduled.
The singer's team has not yet been reported to have responded.
stories.alt: Macklemore performing on stage
stories.credit: Photo: Alpine425 / Flickr, CC BY 2.0

stories.h: Bayern Munich issues a statement after coach Vincent Kompany collapses during training
stories.p: Bayern Munich has released a statement after manager Vincent Kompany reportedly collapsed during a training session. The club is expected to provide further updates on his condition.
more: Supporters have sent messages of support online.
stories.alt: Vincent Kompany waving to fans
stories.credit: Photo: Mike Serigrapher / Flickr, CC BY 2.0

stories.h: Sina Rambo's estranged wife responds to fresh reports of trouble in their marriage
stories.p: Heidi Korth has publicly responded after new reports of a crisis in her marriage to singer Sina Rambo. The singer has not been widely reported to have commented.
more: The couple's situation is drawing wide discussion online.
stories.alt: A pair of wedding rings (stock image)
stories.credit: Stock image: firemedic58 / Flickr, CC BY 2.0

stories.h: Video of Wizkid's father sparks a heated debate among fans
stories.p: A viral video of Wizkid's father has divided fans online, with an older post by the singer about his father resurfacing in the argument.
more: Fans of rival artistes have joined the conversation.
stories.alt: Wizkid performing at a concert
stories.credit: Photo: TCD PHOTOGRAPHY/The TCD Concept Ltd / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 3.0

stories.h: Khloe Kardashian says her track record makes her distrust her own judgement with men
stories.p: Reality star Khloe Kardashian says she has been single for four years and does not trust herself when it comes to relationships because of her past.
more: The remarks have been widely shared on social media.
stories.alt: Khloe Kardashian speaking into a microphone
stories.credit: Photo: Eva Rinaldi Celebrity Photographer / Flickr, CC BY-SA 2.0

stories.h: APC and ADC trade accusations over deepfake videos and a forged letter ahead of Tinubu's Kaduna rally
stories.p: The APC has accused Atiku Abubakar and the ADC of plotting fake news, citing deepfake videos and a forged letter, to disrupt the party's Kaduna campaign rally. The ADC has rejected the claim and challenged the APC to produce evidence.
more: The ADC says the APC must publish proof of its allegation.
The row comes as both camps step up 2027 campaign activity.
stories.alt: People looking at their smartphones
stories.credit: Stock image: nodstrum / Flickr, CC BY 2.0

stories.h: Umahi challenges Peter Obi's argument that Igbos should take just four years
stories.p: Works Minister David Umahi has questioned Peter Obi's reasoning on a single four-year term for an Igbo president, asking why others did eight years while Igbos are told to settle for four.
more: The remark adds to the debate on an Igbo presidency in 2027.
Obi's camp had not responded at the time of writing.
stories.alt: Peter Obi speaking into a microphone
stories.credit: Photo: Plus TV Africa / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 3.0

stories.h: Content creator Genevieve urges Nigerians to stop voting along tribal lines
stories.p: Creator Genevieve has urged voters to put competence and good governance ahead of ethnic loyalty in 2027, in a message that reportedly criticised some Tinubu supporters.
more: Her post has drawn mixed reactions online.
Several creators have been weighing in on the 2027 race.
stories.alt: Ballot boxes lined up on tables (stock image)
stories.credit: Stock image: secretlondon123 / Flickr, CC BY-SA 2.0

stories.h: Tonto Dikeh causes a stir by calling out names while delivering a prophecy in church
stories.p: Actress Tonto Dikeh reportedly named specific people while delivering a prophecy during a church service, and a video of the moment is drawing reactions online.
more: Fans are split over whether the moment was appropriate.
She had not publicly explained the remarks at the time of writing.

stories.h: Egungun of Lagos thanks Zlatan for helping him buy his first costume seven years ago
stories.p: Masquerade performer Egungun of Lagos has publicly thanked singer Zlatan, saying he gave him money to buy his first costume, as the singer's wedding celebrations continue.
more: The message went viral during the wedding celebrations.

stories.h: Ruth Kadiri says expensive weddings put unnecessary pressure on couples
stories.p: Nollywood actress Ruth Kadiri has said couples do not need an expensive wedding, noting the strain big ceremonies place on newlyweds.
more: Her comments follow the talk around lavish weddings this weekend.
stories.alt: Ruth Kadiri in a brown jacket and pearl earrings against a dark green background
stories.credit: Image: social media

stories.h: Itele explains why he defended Irewole Olaniyan amid controversy
stories.p: Itele has said he stood up for Irewole Olaniyan because he does not want to see her fall, as the controversy around her continues to draw reactions.
more: Reactions online remain divided.

stories.h: Calls reportedly grow for Atiku to drop his 2027 presidential ambition
stories.p: Atiku Abubakar, the ADC's 2027 presidential candidate, is reportedly facing fresh calls to withdraw from the race. The report says a new reason has emerged behind the demand, though the details are still being discussed.
more: The call comes as parties step up their 2027 campaigns
Atiku earlier criticised President Tinubu over his remarks on hunger
stories.alt: Portrait of Atiku Abubakar
stories.credit: Photo: Atiku Abubakar / Flickr, CC BY 2.0

stories.h: Video of Davido and Zlatan pleading with the bride's parents at the wedding stirs online buzz
stories.p: A clip from Zlatan Ibile and Davita's wedding reportedly shows Davido joining the groom to plead with the bride's parents during the traditional ceremony. The video has drawn wide reaction online, with many fans praising the friendship.
more: Davido arrived at the venue in a white Rolls-Royce
Several celebrities were photographed among the guests
stories.alt: Davido performing on stage in Lagos
stories.credit: Photo: Kaizenify / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0

stories.h: Met Police reportedly forwards a letter about Meghan's father to the Sussexes' office
stories.p: London's Metropolitan Police has reportedly passed on a letter containing allegations about Thomas Markle Sr. to the office of the Duke and Duchess of Sussex. The contents of the letter have not been made public.
more: The report says the force acted as a forwarding step
Neither side has publicly commented in detail
stories.alt: Meghan, Duchess of Sussex, smiling
stories.credit: Photo: Northern Ireland Office / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 2.0

stories.h: Philanthropist Okwuluora vows to personally fund woman's medical treatment, says no fundraising needed
stories.p: Popular philanthropist Okwuluora says he will take full responsibility for the medical treatment of a woman whose condition has drawn wide public attention, paying all costs from his own pocket until she recovers. He plans to send her photograph to doctors at Parklane Hospital and the University of Nigeria Teaching Hospital (UNTH) in Enugu for assessment, then bring her and her family in for treatment once they approve. He said he first stepped back because some people around her appeared more interested in the money that could be raised than in her wellbeing, but he has now decided to go ahead without any public fundraising. Once she has recovered, he said, an account could be opened for well-wishers who want to support her.
more: Okwuluora said concerns about her safety made him reconsider his involvement before he decided to proceed.
Her case has also sparked a debate online, with some Nigerians asking why pastors who claim to perform healing miracles have not stepped forward to help her.
Others are asking why cases like hers so often depend on expensive treatment and public donations.
stories.alt: A woman in a yellow and black print dress, her body visibly swollen, crosses a road beside a tricycle
stories.credit: Image: social media

stories.h: Video of Nigerian soldiers dipping bread in river water sparks outrage
stories.p: A video circulating online appears to show Nigerian soldiers in the field crouching at a muddy riverbank and dipping bread into the water before eating it. The footage has drawn an emotional response from Nigerians, many of whom say it shows the tough conditions troops face while fighting insecurity. The Nigerian Army has not commented on the video, and it is not yet clear when or where it was recorded.
more: Many users have contrasted the scene with the large sums being spent on campaigns ahead of the 2027 elections.
Others are calling for better welfare, rations and supplies for troops on the front line.
Trend Naija has not independently confirmed the details of the video.
stories.alt: Two Nigerian soldiers in camouflage crouch at a muddy riverbank, dipping pieces of bread into the brown water
stories.credit: Image: social media

stories.h: Unverified claims about Regina Daniels' family and close circle spread online
stories.p: Nollywood actress Regina Daniels is trending after a wave of unconfirmed claims about her family and people close to her spread on Instagram. Posts suggest her mother has raised concerns about some people in her daughter's circle, but the details being shared have not been backed up by any official source. Neither Regina nor her family has publicly responded, and Trend Naija has not been able to verify any of the reports.
more: There is no confirmation of any police involvement, despite claims being shared online.
None of the people mentioned in the posts has been shown to have done anything wrong.
Fans are urging caution, saying matters of family and health deserve privacy until the facts are clear.
stories.alt: Regina Daniels shares a hug with a woman in a matching black top
stories.credit: Image: social media

stories.h: Jarvis tells critics to stop pushing her to respect Peller
stories.p: Streamer Jarvis has hit back at people urging her to show more respect to her husband Peller, saying they should stop forcing it because the respect is not there. She added that women reflect whatever they are given in a relationship. The remarks have sparked fresh reactions online, about two months into their reported marriage.
more: "Whatever you show us is what we will reflect back," Jarvis said.
The comments follow the couple's recent public clashes, including a row over her younger sister.
Fans are divided, with many pointing out that respect in a marriage has to go both ways.
stories.alt: Peller and Jarvis pose side by side in matching white England football shirts
stories.credit: Photo: Trend Naija

stories.h: Zlatan and Davita Lamai's traditional wedding gets underway
stories.p: Rapper Zlatan Ibile and Davita Lamai's traditional wedding is underway, with the singer releasing photos from the ceremony on Saturday. The pictures sent "Zlatan" and "Zanku" into Nigeria's top social media trends. Claims of a ₦2.3 billion wedding and a $1 million ring have not been backed up by any credible or official source.
more: The couple posed in matching red and white outfits with coral beads in the official photos.
Zlatan was earlier reported to have bought his bride a Hermes bag ahead of the wedding.
Big names from the entertainment industry are expected to celebrate with the couple.
stories.alt: Davita Lamai in a red beaded gown and coral crown stands beside Zlatan, seated on a gold throne in white and coral beads
stories.credit: Photo: Trend Naija

stories.h: Remi Tinubu and Tompolo share a cheerful moment at an APC rally
stories.p: First Lady Senator Oluremi Tinubu and Government Ekpemupolo, popularly known as Tompolo, were seen laughing and exchanging warm smiles at an APC rally. Tompolo, a former Niger Delta militant leader, now holds a major federal pipeline security contract and has become an influential figure with ties to the ruling party. The relaxed moment has sparked conversation online about how political relationships evolve in Nigeria.
more: Tompolo wore a cap and vest bearing the name of a pro-Tinubu support group.
His firm's pipeline surveillance contract has been credited by the government with helping to curb oil theft in the Niger Delta.
The rally is part of the APC's 2027 re-election campaign.
stories.alt: Remi Tinubu in green APC attire smiles at Tompolo, seated beside her in a white cap and black vest
stories.credit: Photo: Trend Naija

stories.h: Blessing CEO out of detention, Doris Ogala confirms
stories.p: Relationship coach Blessing CEO has been released from detention, actress Doris Ogala has confirmed. Ogala shared a video on social media showing her on a video call with Blessing shortly after her release.
more: Ogala appeared delighted in the clip as she spoke with Blessing.
Blessing CEO has not yet spoken publicly about her release.
stories.alt: Doris Ogala in a cap, sunglasses and striped top smiling during a video call in a car
stories.credit: Photo: Trend Naija

stories.h: VeryDarkMan calls Davido and his uncle a disappointment over development in Osun
stories.p: VeryDarkMan has described Davido and his uncle, Osun State Governor Ademola Adeleke, as a disappointment, criticising what he called poor development in the state. He asked how a family that owns private jets could have so much wealth while Osun still lacks a functioning airport, and how investors are expected to reach the state easily. He urged those in power to use government resources to improve people's lives.
more: VDM also spoke about a past invitation from Davido's brother, B-Red, to meet their father.
Neither Davido nor the Osun State government has responded to the comments.
Fans are split on whether his criticism is fair or too harsh on the Adeleke family.
stories.alt: VeryDarkMan speaking in a selfie video beside a photo of Davido shaking hands with Governor Ademola Adeleke
stories.credit: Photo: Trend Naija

stories.h: Supporters reportedly carrying sticks and cutlasses arrive for Tinubu's campaign flag-off in Kaduna
stories.p: Some APC supporters were reportedly seen holding sticks and cutlasses as crowds streamed into Ranchers Bees Stadium in Kaduna for the flag-off of President Tinubu's re-election campaign. Many others arrived in party caps and T-shirts, carrying posters of the president. Footage of the arrivals has drawn concern online about safety at campaign events.
more: The Kaduna rally is the first major stop of the APC's 2027 campaign tour.
The party has not commented on the reports of supporters carrying weapons.
Port Harcourt is reportedly the next stop on the campaign trail.
stories.alt: Crowds in party caps and T-shirts, some holding APC posters, arrive at a stadium in Kaduna
stories.credit: Photo: Trend Naija

stories.h: Man sees his new face for the first time, 24 hours after his own child gave him a facelift
stories.p: A viral video shows a father looking at his new face for the first time, just a day after a facelift performed by his own child. Before and after images show his face still swollen and taped, with surgical dressings still in place shortly after the operation. Viewers have been amazed that he barely recognised himself.
more: Swelling is normal so soon after surgery, so the final result could look quite different once he heals.
The healing process for a facelift usually takes weeks to settle.
Many viewers praised the child for trusting their skills on their own parent.
stories.alt: Before surgery, bandaged after the operation, and 24 hours after: an older man's face during facelift recovery
stories.credit: Photo: Trend Naija
